problem:
Let $p=⟨-1,1,1⟩$ and $q=⟨4,8,2⟩.$ Find the vector projection of $q$ onto $p.$

${\text{proj}}_{p}\,q=⟨$  

{{field-1}},

{{field-2}},

{{field-3}}

$⟩$
worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{p}\,q & =\frac{p\cdot q}{p\cdot p}p \\  & =\frac{{p}_{x}{q}_{x}+{p}_{y}{q}_{y}+{p}_{z}{q}_{z}}{{p}_{x}^{2}+{p}_{y}^{2}+{p}_{z}^{2}}p \\  & =\frac{(-1)\cdot 4+1\cdot 8+1\cdot 2}{(-1)^{2}+{1}^{2}+{1}^{2}}p \\  & =\frac{6}{3}⟨-1,1,1⟩ \\  & =⟨-2,2,2⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
